tooltip.createnetherite.netherite_fluid_: Stores %sx as much fluid as a regular Fluid Tank.
gui.booster.netherite_filter.key_hint: Hover an item and press 1-4 to assign its mode
gui.booster.netherite_fan.fallback: Unmatched items use the selected mode
message.createnetherite.netherite_blaze_: This burner already holds four Blazes.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_power: Connect rotational power to the shaft at the back of the fan.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_no_med: Right-click the fan to choose a processing mode. No water, lava or fire block is needed in front of it.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_washin: Washing: coloured wool becomes white wool.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_blasti: Blasting: raw iron becomes an iron ingot.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_filter: Hold a Netherite Filter and right-click to edit its four processing groups.
Drag in samples, or hover an inventory item and press 1–4: Washing, Blasting, Haunting, Smoking.
Each group holds nine item samples. Samples do not consume real items.
Right-click the fan, then place the configured filter into its filter slot.
Listed items follow their filter rules, even in the same air current.
Unlisted items use the fan's selected mode. This beef is smoked.
You can still change the selected mode with a filter installed. Listed items keep their rules.
Unlisted blue wool now uses Washing; the listed raw iron is still blasted.
createnetherite.ponder.shared.fan_transp: Place items on a depot or belt in the air current, or drop them into the airflow.
createnetherite.ponder.netherite_fan_fil: Filter rules and the selected mode
block.createnetherite.powerful_mechanica: Pumps fluids through connected pipes with _increased throughput_. Supply rotational power to move fluids between tanks and machines.
block.createnetherite.netherite_fluid_ta: Stores fluids in a _multiblock tank_. Supply water and heat, then attach _Netherite Steam Engines_ to use it as a boiler.
block.createnetherite.netherite_steam_en: Converts boiler steam into _rotational power_. Attach to a Netherite Fluid Tank boiler. Each engine supports up to _256 times_ the output of a regular Steam Engine.
block.createnetherite.netherite_item_vau: Stores items in a _multiblock vault_ with _16 times_ the slots of a regular Item Vault.
block.createnetherite.netherite_elevator: Moves elevator contraptions _vertically_. Travels at _twice_ the regular Elevator Pulley speed at the same RPM.
block.createnetherite.netherite_mechanic: Presses items on depots, belts or in a basin. _Batch processing_ repeats matching basin recipes in one working cycle, with the same stress cost as a regular Mechanical Press.
block.createnetherite.netherite_blaze_bu: Holds up to _four Blazes_ to heat machines and boilers. Each Blaze supplies _1 times_ the normal boiler heat and consumes _0.5 times_ the fuel.
Captures _one Blaze_ per right-click until all four places are filled. An empty burner supplies no heat and consumes no fuel.
block.createnetherite.netherite_mechanic: Transfers items between selected input and output points. Movement speed, movement speed cap and working radius are _3 times_ those of a regular Mechanical Arm; stress cost is _1.5 times_ as high.
Mixes recipes in a basin. _Batch processing_ repeats the matching recipe in one mixing cycle. Movement, heating requirements and stress cost follow the regular Mechanical Mixer.
item.createnetherite.netherite_sheet.too: An _upgrade material_ used to craft Netherite variants of Create machines.
block.createnetherite.netherite_wireless: Activate through a Netherite Infinite Manager _across dimensions, at any distance_, without frequencies. Outputs a _strength-15_ redstone signal for _1 second_ and keeps its chunk loaded for _15 seconds_. Right-click to edit its name and visibility.
item.createnetherite.netherite_infinite_: Right-click to list _your terminals_ and _public terminals_ placed by other players. _Select across pages_ to activate several at once. Sending renews the 1-second signal and 15-second chunk-loading lease, without frequencies or distance limits.
wireless.createnetherite.owner_only: Only the player who placed this terminal can edit it.
gui.createnetherite.wireless.name: Terminal name
gui.createnetherite.wireless.empty: No terminals available. Place a terminal first.
